measurement: Read-only analysis of existing logs, Ninja dependency records and current generated commands; no fresh compile or linker benchmark.
caveats: Ninja log has retained/recompacted historical entries and does not prove thermal or antivirus causes.

No before/after optimization benchmark was run while the shared verification was active.
